case_manifest.scope: Balanced v2 covers all 8 binary Up/Down states. Other impairments are selected tests. Legacy v1 retains the original definitions.

data_kind: synthetic exogenous replay; not live flexiWAN or measured packet throughput

model_metadata.selection: minimum validation MAE among max_depth 3 and 5; no benchmark access
model_metadata.split: whole episodes in chronological order; histories and future targets never cross episodes
model_metadata.label: actual metric at t+30 seconds (not scenario ID or future path label)
model_metadata.target_mode: future metric minus current metric; MAE objective
model_metadata.deployment_gate: XGBoost enabled per metric only if validation MAE improves persistence by >=2%; otherwise persistence

pass_criteria.notes: SLA measured only when a true healthy path exists; first 10s of each incident excluded from SLA/safety. All-down is safe handling, not connectivity restoration.

limitations: Only the 8 binary Up/Down states are exhaustive; other impairment cases are selected tests.
Initial priority is WAN1; targeting WAN2/WAN3 also exercises standby handling, not guaranteed active-path failover.
No real network, controller job latency, traffic feedback, or flow/session migration is modeled.
Available bandwidth is a capacity proxy, not measured goodput.
Sudden faults have no guaranteed predictive precursors.
Safety and failover gains partly come from guardrails, not from ML.
S07 cannot restore connectivity; it only measures correct no-path detection.
Scenario pass requires every application profile to pass for >=95% of seeds; uncertainty is resampled by seed.
